outcome: Cardiovascular disease risk factors (lipids, anthropometric indices, glycaemic indices, oxidative stress)
Vascular function (arterial compliance, retinal microvasculature, uterine artery mean pulsatility index)
cohort: The study will include HIV positive pregnant women on ART and HIV negative pregnant women, along with their offspring.
finding: The study intends to investigate how HIV infection and antiretroviral treatments may affect the cardiovascular health of mothers and their offspring at various time points during pregnancy and up to 2 years after birth.
